subject: Request: Evidence of Access Handback, Background Checks & Training — Cedar Bank SOC2
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@cedarbank.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security_ops@cedarbank.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC 2 review

Markus,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of Cedar Bank's readiness assessment for the upcoming SOC 2 review, our audit team needs a sampling of evidence around employee lifecycle controls (onboarding, background checks, security training, and deprovisioning). Can you provide the following items (redacted as needed):

- Training completion roster for the last 12 months (employee id or anonymized id + course + completion date).
- Background check summary: confirmation of checks performed and a redacted sample of a background-check report (no PII — initials and redaction guidance are fine).
- Deprovisioning/access handback log for system accounts and privileged groups (last 12 months) — export with timestamps, actor, and affected entitlement.
- SSO/IdP change log excerpt for role/group removals tied to terminations (sample events).

Also let us know the redaction process you use and whether you can map these items to SIG or CAIQ control IDs (we don't need the full mapping now, just whether you can provide it).

Ideal timeline: can we get samples within 5 business days? If you need an NDA or a secure upload route, tell me preferred method (we can provide a secure upload portal or a signed DPA).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Cedar is pushing for this before their audit kickoff on 06/25.

Best,
Lisa Grant
Senior Security Program Manager
Cedar Bank

Attachments: (none listed)
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodai.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@cedarbank.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC 2 review

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We'll get samples together; quick answers below and a proposed plan: 

What we can provide within 5 business days:
- Training completion roster: yes — we can provide a CSV with anonymized IDs and completion dates.
- Background check summary: yes — we will attach our redaction guidance and a single redacted sample report.
- Deprovisioning/access handback log: yes — attaching an export (access_revocation_log.csv) with timestamps and action types.
- SSO/IdP change log: yes — we can export role/group removals, but may need to coordinate a short window with our IdP admin to extract the event details.

Two quick clarifying questions:
1) For the background sample, what redaction level is acceptable? (Initials only, employee ID with prefix, or hashed IDs?)
2) Do you want a CAIQ/SIG control mapping now or can we provide sample IDs after we deliver the raw artifacts?

Attaching: access_revocation_log.csv (stub - contains 90 days of deprov events; full 12-month export to follow).

Plan: Irene (HR security) will produce the background and training artifacts; Grace (platform ops) will pull a full IdP export and privileged-group removal examples. We'll upload via the secure link you prefer; if you send the portal link we'll push the files there.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- access_revocation_log.csv (CSV export — sample 90-day rows)
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodai.com>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@cedarbank.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC 2 review

Lisa / Markus,

Following up with the artifacts we discussed. Attached are two files and a short note about our process: 

Attachments included in this upload:
- onboarding_matrix.csv — lists role templates, required training modules, and nominal access groups (anonymized role ids).
- background_redaction_instructions.pdf — our HR redaction policy and a redacted sample background report.

Background checks: our standard pre-hire checks include identity verification, employment verification, and criminal record checks where local law permits. For the audit sample, we used hashed candidate IDs (SHA256 partial) and removed DOB and SSN fields. If Cedar needs initials-only instead, we can regenerate a sample quickly.

Training: we track security training completions through our LMS; the onboarding_matrix maps which courses are mandatory per role. We'll export the LMS completion roster as a separate CSV (can be anonymized as hashed employee_id + course + completion_date).

Deprovisioning and privileged group removals: Grace will provide the full 12-month privileged-removal export. Note: contractor offboards are separated from FT/PTE in the export; do you want contractors included in the sample?

Upload / transfer method: we've placed these artifacts in a secure S3 bucket (pre-signed URLs) and can send a DocuSign-protected transfer if you prefer. Sharing link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/transfers/cedar-20270614 (expires in 7 days).

Let me know redaction preference and whether to include contractors.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
HR Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- onboarding_matrix.csv (role templates + required courses)
- background_redaction_instructions.pdf (redaction policy + sample)
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@cedarbank.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security_ops@cedarbank.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC 2 review

Markus / Irene,

Received the files — thanks, these look good and are on track for our sample set. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize for the auditor:

- Redaction: initials + hashed employee id is fine for the background sample.
- Please include contractors in the deprovisioning sample (we'll annotate them separately).
- One more item: can you provide an anonymized, timestamped example of a privileged-group removal where the removal was performed as part of a termination (not a role change)? The auditor likes to see the sequence: termination event -> ticket/approval -> group removal timestamp. A single anonymized sequence is sufficient.

If you can upload that sequence and confirm the secure link (or post to the portal), we'll pull everything into our audit workspace. Expect a short follow-up from our auditor with any mapping questions to SIG controls.

Best,
Lisa Grant
Senior Security Program Manager
Cedar Bank

P.S. If easier, we can schedule a 20-minute walkthrough next week to review the exports rather than doing follow-ups over email.
